query:
SELECT 
  dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  COUNT(m.id) as totalMeetings,
  MAX(CASE WHEN m.timeSlot = 9 THEN 'BOOKED' ELSE NULL END) as slot9Status,
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.companyName LIKE '%Symphony%' THEN 'YES' ELSE NULL END) as metSymphony
FROM delegateProfiles dp
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE dp.attendeeId = '8196151'
GROUP BY dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company;
